mapper.insert: INSERT INTO luck_business_knowledge (id, title, type, question, content, enabled, embedding_status, error_msg, source_filename, file_path, file_size, file_type, splitter_type, model_id, del_flag, is_resource_cleaned, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{type}, #{question}, #{content}, #{enabled}, #{embeddingStatus}, #{errorMsg}, #{sourceFilename}, #{reportPath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{splitterType}, #{modelId}, #{delFlag}, #{isResourceCleaned}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, type, question, content, enabled, embedding_status, error_msg, source_filename, file_path, file_size, file_type, splitter_type, model_id, del_flag, is_resource_cleaned, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM luck_business_knowledge WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT id FROM luck_business_knowledge WHERE enabled = 1 AND del_flag = 0 AND embedding_status = 'COMPLETED'
